description: Draws a field of coloured polygons that drift out from a centre, with a knob and a CV jack for every property of them

params.text: Sets how many particles are drawn, 0 to 20000
Turns each particle about its own centre, -180 to +180 degrees
Sets how many corners each particle has, 0 to 10, and a particle left with none is not drawn at all
Sets how solid each particle is, 0 for invisible and 255 for fully opaque
Bends the outlines by stretching the angle between their corners, 0 for none to 10
Sets the width of the outline drawn round each particle, 0 to 10
Sets the size of the particles, 0 to 200, before each one's own random share is added
Turns the whole field of particles about the centre of the picture, -180 to +180 degrees
Sets how much of each particle's own fixed random angle, 0 to 360 degrees, is added to ROTATE, 0 for none and 1 for all of it
Sets how much of each particle's own fixed random corner count, 1 to 5, is added to EDGES, 0 for none and 1 for all of it
Sets how much of each particle's own fixed random opacity, 1 to 250, is added to OPACITY, 0 for none and 1 for all of it
Adds a second bending that stretches the corners sideways as well, 0 for none to 5
Sets how much of each particle's own fixed random width, 0 to 3, is added to STROKE, 0 for none and 1 for all of it
Sets how much of each particle's own fixed random radius, 1 to 50, is added to RADIUS, 0 for none and 1 for all of it
Sets how fast the particles are carried round the centre, -1 to +1, and holds them at one angle at 0
Shifts the whole picture sideways, -100 to +100
Shifts the whole picture up and down, -100 to +100
Sets how fast each particle travels out from the centre, -10 to +10; a particle driven back past the centre turns round and travels out again
Scales the red in every particle, 10 for full strength and 0 for none; a negative setting wraps the number round rather than removing the red
Scales the green in every particle, 10 for full strength and 0 for none; a negative setting wraps the number round rather than removing the green
Scales the blue in every particle, 10 for full strength and 0 for none; a negative setting wraps the number round rather than removing the blue
Puts every particle back to the place and the random shape it was given when the module was added

inputs.text: Adds one particle per volt to the AMOUNT knob
Turns each particle further, 18 degrees per volt, added to the ROTATE knob
Adds one corner per volt to the EDGES knob
Adds 25.5 of opacity per volt to the OPACITY knob
Adds a tenth of a unit of distortion per volt to the DISTORT knob
Adds one unit of outline width per volt to the STROKE knob
Adds 50 of radius per volt to the RADIUS knob
Turns the whole field further, 18 degrees per volt, added to the ROTATE ALL knob
Adds a tenth per volt to the randomness on ROTATE
Adds a whole unit per volt to the randomness on EDGES, whose own travel stops at 1
Adds a tenth per volt to the randomness on OPACITY
Adds half a unit per volt to the MORE knob
Adds a whole unit per volt to the randomness on STROKE, whose own travel stops at 1
Adds a tenth per volt to the randomness on RADIUS
Adds a tenth per volt to the ROT. SPEED knob
Shifts the picture sideways by 10 more per volt, added to the X knob
Shifts the picture up and down by 10 more per volt, added to the Y knob
Adds one unit per volt to the SPEED knob
Adds one unit per volt to the RED knob
Adds one unit per volt to the GREEN knob
Adds one unit per volt to the BLUE knob
Puts every particle back to its starting place while the voltage here is above 0V; it is a level and not an edge, so a held gate keeps the picture pinned at its start

notes: The picture is the large black square, which carries no controls and cannot be clicked for help.
The particles, their settings and the running rotation are kept in file-wide variables rather than per module, so two of these in one patch share a single field of particles.
None of the CV jacks is limited: the sum of knob and voltage is used as it stands, so a jack can carry a setting well past the end of its own knob's travel.
